mechanism_narrative: A strong increase in GDP growth rate signals a growing economy, leading to higher consumer spending and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in > 50% of instances with strong GDP growth, or walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.01 over any 1-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the federal funds rate below 1.5% signals an easing monetary cycle, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
